subject_company: Target / issuer whose securities are sought. In an issuer tender offer, issuer is both subject_company and bidder. Not the purchasing offeror in a third-party tender.
bidder: Offeror / purchasing party making the tender offer. In an issuer tender, same as subject_company.
security_description: Class/type of security being tendered (short description), not the full deal narrative.
cusip: CUSIP only (typically 9 characters). null if absent.
offer_price: Consideration for tendered shares. Prefer explicit cash amount (e.g. "$25.00 per share"). NAV-based deals: short NAV phrasing. Not a bare calendar day.
currency: ISO-like currency of the cash offer price (e.g. USD). Explicit code / 'U.S. dollars' → that code; per-share cash with only $ / £ / € → USD / GBP / EUR. Reject par value, fees, aggregate millions, NAV-only, or lone $. Prefer null over a guess.
expiration_date: Offer expiration date/time (include time/zone if stated). Not settlement, commencement, or filing dates.
withdrawal_deadline: Deadline to withdraw tendered shares (often same as expiration). null unless withdrawal language supports it.
settlement_date: Payment / acceptance timing. Prefer 'Payment: promptly' when the filing says payment will be made promptly after acceptance; otherwise an explicit pay/accept date.
effective_date: Legal effectiveness of the transaction — merger closed/consummated/effective, or issuer repurchase as-of / Valuation Date when that is the repurchase as-of. REJECT commencement, expiration, withdrawal, filing/notice, settlement-only, and NAV-as-price-basis without repurchase-as-of. Prefer null (most standalones).
minimum_tender_condition: Use exactly "No minimum tender condition" when there is none; otherwise the threshold clause. If text only says a Minimum Condition was satisfied without stating the threshold → null.
proration_terms: Oversubscription / pro-rata acceptance rule (often starts with 'If more than…'). Preserve numbers; omit thousands separators. Do not calculate a %. Do not infer from a purchase limit alone. "No proration" only if explicitly stated. null if not discussed.
